title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold9 May Bring Back Under-Display Camera
excerpt: Reports suggest Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Z Fold9 could reintroduce the under-display selfie camera feature after a two-year absence.
body_html:
Samsung is reportedly considering the return of an under-display selfie camera for its upcoming Galaxy Z Fold9 smartphone. According to recent reports, this feature could make a comeback after being absent for two years.

If the plans move forward, users would see the return of the camera technology hidden beneath the main display. Specific details regarding the upcoming device remain limited as planning is still underway.
